Overview

Experience Afghanistan with local context.

Discover the fascinating layers of Afghanistan's capital city and its nearby valleys, exploring bustling bazaars, historic gardens, and spectacular mountain passes.

Route: Kabul → Kabul / Panjshir → Kabul / Nangarhar → Kabul / Paghman

Itinerary

6-day journey

The itinerary is grouped by the places you stay, so you can see how the journey moves through Afghanistan. Daily plans may shift with road conditions, weather, local access, and the final interests of your group.

Kabul City

5 nights in total · nights of Days 1–5

Day 1: Arrival and Kabul old-city orientation

Arrival support and an introductory walk through Kabul’s older commercial lanes, useful for guests who want context before moving into surrounding valleys.

Tonight Kabul City Location Kabul Food & culture Kabob
Today's highlights

Day 2: Core Kabul heritage circuit

A focused day on Kabul’s major heritage sites: the National Museum, Darulaman Palace, Babur’s Gardens, and selected religious or viewpoint stops based on access.

Tonight Kabul City Location Kabul Food & culture Qabuli Palaw
Today's highlights

Day 3: Panjshir day excursion

Early departure north through Parwan toward Panjshir, with valley stops, Massoud Mausoleum, and time along the river corridor before returning to Kabul.

Tonight Kabul City Location Kabul / Panjshir Food & culture Green Tea
Today's highlights

Day 4: Jalalabad corridor or Nangarhar day route

A route-dependent eastern day toward Darunta Lake and Jalalabad-area cultural sites when access and timing are suitable. If conditions are weak, the day remains in Kabul.

Tonight Kabul City Location Kabul / Nangarhar Food & culture Sambosa
Today's highlights

Day 5: Paghman, Qargha, and west Kabul

A relaxed day combining lakeside scenery, Paghman landmarks, and west Kabul neighborhoods. This day also provides flexibility if an earlier day was delayed.

Tonight Kabul City Location Kabul / Paghman Food & culture Bolani
Today's highlights

Day 6: Departure support

Hotel check-out, final shopping or tea stop if time allows, and airport transfer.

Tonight Departure day — no overnight Location Kabul Food & culture Green Tea

Today's highlight

Know before you go

Practical trip information

Open each section for the planning information most relevant to this journey.

Passport, visa & entry requirements

Entry requirements depend on nationality and current rules. AfghanTours can explain the supporting documentation available for confirmed travelers, but travelers should verify current official requirements before departure.

Arrival & departure information

Arrival and departure transfers are coordinated around the confirmed itinerary and flight schedule. Final pickup details are provided before travel.

Physical activity level & mobility

This tour is rated Leisurely. Walking, altitude, road time, stairs, uneven surfaces, and other physical requirements are reviewed during trip planning.

Transportation on tour

4WD vehicles

Typical transport: SUV (Standard / Older Model), 4x4 SUV (Premium / Newer Model), Toyota Land Cruiser 200

Clothing & packing tips

Packing guidance is provided before departure. Clothing and equipment needs vary by season, altitude, destination, and the activities included in your itinerary.

Hotels on tour

3-star and 4-star hotels in central Kabul

Health

Travelers should discuss personal medical needs, vaccinations, medications, altitude concerns, and travel insurance with qualified professionals before departure. Tell AfghanTours about mobility or dietary requirements that affect trip planning.

Meals & Afghan cuisine

Meals vary by region and itinerary. Local dishes and food experiences can be incorporated where practical, and dietary requirements should be discussed before travel.

Currency & payments

Cash remains the most practical form of payment for many day-to-day expenses in Afghanistan, and card acceptance is limited. Current money guidance is provided before departure.

Wi-Fi, mobile data & connectivity

Mobile data and Wi-Fi are available in many cities and hotels, but speed and reliability vary significantly along the route.

Guides & on-tour support

Trips are coordinated by AfghanTours from Kabul with local guides, drivers, hotels, and other partners selected according to the itinerary.

Photography

Photography rules vary by location. Travelers should ask before photographing people and follow local guidance around government, military, religious, and other sensitive sites.

Time zones

Afghanistan uses Afghanistan Time (UTC+4:30) throughout the year.

Responsible travel

Guests are expected to respect local customs, dress guidance, religious practices, communities, photography preferences, and site-specific instructions throughout the journey.

Kabul & Surroundings

This tour focuses on Kabul and its surrounding regions, offering visits to historical sites, gardens, and museums.

Tour Profile

  • Duration: 6 days
  • Travel style: Cultural / Scenic
  • Activity level: Leisurely
  • Season: Year-round

What This Tour Is For

This trip uses Kabul as the base for a deeper look at the capital and selected day routes beyond it. The current itinerary combines Kabul heritage with a Panjshir day, a conditional eastern route toward Nangarhar, and a western Kabul/Paghman day, with outside excursions adjusted when access or timing does not support them.

Planning Notes

Final routing, hotels, transport, and pricing should be confirmed after reviewing group size, travel dates, road conditions, flight availability, permits, and current local operating requirements.

Ramadan Travel Advisory

This departure takes place during Ramadan.

AfghanTours remains open for business and tours continue to operate during Ramadan.

Travelers should expect some adjustments to normal daily routines. Restaurant and shop opening hours may change, daytime meal arrangements may require additional planning, and some visits or activities may be scheduled differently around prayer times and the evening iftar period.

Ramadan can also offer travelers a distinctive view of daily life in Afghanistan, particularly in the evenings when families and communities gather to break the fast.

AfghanTours will plan the departure around the operating conditions and opening hours in effect at the time and advise confirmed travelers of any material itinerary adjustments.
